deals.title: Spotify Premium Student
deals.eligibility: Students at an accredited US college or university, verified through Spotify; re-verify each year, up to four years.
deals.howToGet: Sign up on Spotify's student page and verify your enrolment. The first month is free. The price covers Spotify Premium and Hulu (With Ads).
deals.sourceQuote: just $6.99/month after. Save up to $17.99/month. Cancel anytime. Spotify Premium Normally $12.99/month
